query: WITH annual_counts AS (SELECT YEAR(graduation_date) AS grad_year, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS bachelor_count FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala WHERE TRIM(qualification) = 'بكالوريوس' AND NOT graduation_date IS NULL AND YEAR(graduation_date) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2025 GROUP BY YEAR(graduation_date)) SELECT grad_year, bachelor_count, LAG(bachelor_count) OVER (ORDER BY grad_year) AS prev_year_count, ROUND(((bachelor_count - LAG(bachelor_count) OVER (ORDER BY grad_year)) / LAG(bachelor_count) OVER (ORDER BY grad_year)) * 100.0, 2) AS yoy_growth_rate_pct FROM annual_counts ORDER BY grad_year LIMIT 1200
